title: One plain voice for every line
statement: Every line a student reads gets one plain voice: no praise, no exclamation marks, no verdict the screen already shows, and at most one question, none in a closing line.
detail:
Every line a student reads passes the same cleaner in code: no gushing, at most one question while a try remains and
none in a closing line, no semicolon or dash standing in for a comma, and no opening verdict, since the screen shows
the verdict itself (`g9/transformer/src/house.js`). The rules are a 3D version's reply cleaners and an animated
version's punctuation, used as they are. A test turns "Great job! You found the line. Which word matters? And why?"
into "You found the line. Which word matters?" (`g9/transformer/test/glue.test.mjs`). Before the rule, feedback opened
with "This is correct;" under the build's own YES (`g9/transformer/v02/QA.md`, "Found and fixed").
against:
without the
3D version's code on the machine, its praise and question rules don't run (`g9/transformer/src/glue/threejs.js`). A later run found: another reading course's register for ten-year-olds bans younger-grade praise such as medals and confetti but asks for specific process praise instead, with feedback kept to 40 words and one scaffolding question on a miss, so whether a line may praise at all differs between courses (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0195-g5-book-lane-secret-garden-closed.qmd`). A later run found: a Grade 5 reading course asks for specific process praise that names what the student's move accomplished, rather than no praise, after a review found the same generic praise and medal on all nine lesson endings, though it graded that as polish only (`grade3-reading/artifacts/g5-course/LESSON-AUTHORING-PLAYBOOK.md`). A later run found counter-evidence (`grade3-reading/incept-read-app/apps/broker/WRITING-SCORE.md`). A later run found counter-evidence (`grade3-reading/incept-read-app/docs/G4-SCR-example-native-qti.md`). A later run found counter-evidence (`g9/transcript/chat-transcript.redacted.txt`). A later run found counter-evidence (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/skills/g3-reading-red-team/references/dimensions/D12-motivation-engagement.md`). A later run found counter-evidence (`grade3-reading/artifacts/g5-deploy/EVALUATION-API.md`).
